answer: Trust a new identity only after its graded work survives spot re-performance. Each epoch, a random tenth of identities must redo a fresh variant of one past graded task live within 30 minutes, for example reclassifying ivory, pigment, and nebula samples, scored against the original result. A farm of 1,000 fake identities faces about 100 live re-performances every epoch, with no answer to copy, and each failure burns a 150 POA deposit plus pending rewards and resets standing.
